description:
The up arrow (↑) character is not rendering properly in the status bar. It appears as 'R' instead of '↑' in some contexts.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
R12k ↓1.1k ↑2.4k

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
↑9.6k ↓811 R12k

Issues:
1. The up arrow ↑ appears as 'R' in the Elixir version (e.g., 'R12k' instead of '↑12k' or similar)
2. The down arrow ↓ appears to render correctly
3. The order/placement of token counts differs

The arrow characters should render correctly, and the format should match: ↑[value] ↓[value] R[value] or similar.
title: TUI-12: Arrow characters (↑↓) not rendering properly in status bar
